subject: general
question: Manu purchased a microwave for ₹ 12,000 and sold it to Anuj at a loss of 12.5%. Anuj sold it to Rani at a profit of 20% and Rani sold it to Priya at a profit of 6(2)/(3)\% . Find the price at which Priya purchased it.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Successive multiplier = (1 − 12.5%) × (1 + 20%) × (1 + 6⅔%)

= (7/8) × (6/5) × (16/15)

Cancel ⇒ (7 × 6 × 16) ÷ (8 × 5 × 15) = 672 ÷ 600 = 28/25

Final price = 12000 × (28/25) = 480 × 28 = 13440

**∴ Answer = 13440**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial price = 12000

Loss = 12.5%, Profit = 20%, Profit = 6⅔%

**Formula used:**

New price = Old price × (1 ± percentage)

**Calculation:**

⇒ After 12.5% loss: SP₁ = 12000 × (1 − 12.5/100) = 12000 × 7/8 = 10500

⇒ After 20% profit: SP₂ = 10500 × (1 + 20/100) = 10500 × 6/5 = 12600

⇒ After 6⅔% profit: SP₃ = 12600 × (1 + 20/300) = 12600 × 16/15 = 13440

**∴ The correct answer is 13440.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage

Net effect = multiply individual factors: (1 ± p₁)(1 ± p₂)...

Fraction Conversion

12.5% = 1/8, 20% = 1/5, 6⅔% = 1/15

Multiplier Trick

Loss ⇒ (1 − p), Profit ⇒ (1 + p)

Quick Cancellation

Use fractions to simplify multiplication faster
